Great Food, Lovely Space, and the Kindest Host in Da Lat
Oct 2025 • Friends
Lạch Restaurant is truly a hidden gem in Đà Lạt!
My friends and I — including some of my foreign friends — had a wonderful and memorable experience here. The restaurant is spacious, beautifully designed, and filled with the warm, rustic charm of Vietnam’s ethnic culture. It feels both authentic and welcoming, making it a perfect place to enjoy a meal after exploring the city.

The food was absolutely delicious, with a wide variety of local dishes at very reasonable prices. Every dish tasted fresh and full of flavor — just like a home-cooked meal, but with the care and presentation of a fine restaurant.

The owner, Ms. Hiền, is incredibly charming, fluent in English, and always friendly, polite, and thoughtful. Her hospitality made our visit even more special.

We’ll definitely come back to Lạch Restaurant and recommend it to all our friends who visit Đà Lạt. A must-try experience for anyone who loves great food, beautiful spaces, and genuine people.

Authentic Food, Beautiful Space, and Great Local Partnerships
Sep 2025 • Friends
Lạch Restaurant is one of the most impressive dining spots I’ve visited in Da Lat. The food is truly authentic — traditional Central Highlands dishes cooked with care and full of flavor. The atmosphere is elegant but still cozy, with a beautiful wooden interior that captures the spirit of Da Lat.

The staff were so kind and professional. At the end of our meal, they even told us about Lạch’s partnerships with local places — a 15% discount at Le Retour Pub and 10% off at a nearby spa for restaurant guests. Such a thoughtful touch that makes you feel like part of the local community.

Highly recommended for anyone who wants a genuine taste of Da Lat — both in food and experience!

Lovely Playdate
Sep 2025 • Family
Had a playdate here with some other families. The kids made moon cakes. The staff are very helpful and speak great English and French. Our kids were so happy and proud that they could make such beautiful moon cakes. We had afternoon tea while we were waiting for the kids and dinner here later, both were very good, the sweets taste really high quality, comparable to those in Europe. The dinner on the other hand has lots of new flavors, unlike stuff I've tried before. The staff even suggested a different breed of chicken for us since the normal one could be quite stringy for foreigners. I had a lovely chat with the owner as well, they are very lovely and said they wanted to preserve the ethnic's culture, hence why they got started on this restaurant. Would come back for other workshops and meals
